LUNARTWEAKS 1.11.0 - FREE + PRO

Extract all files and open LunarTweaks.exe.
Continue with Free needs no key/server. Activate Pro & scan accepts Pro and
existing Ultimate keys. Public Pro activation requires the owner's HTTPS
licensing endpoint in LunarTweaks.ini.

Full screen: button, F11 or Alt+Enter. Escape leaves fullscreen first.
Sound on/off and Motion on/off are in the title bar. Preferences are saved.
Short click/completion cues and restrained transitions; no looping ambience.

Free: 20 automatic settings / 60 total entries.
Pro: 31 automatic settings / 110 total entries, plus the desktop preset.
Entries include guides/tools. Actual compatibility depends on this PC.
Review each change; Undo restores saved originals for automatic changes.

This build is unsigned. Windows SmartScreen can show an unrecognized-app
warning. Publisher signing/reputation is not completed by this update.
Windows x64 required. Native runtime testing remains outstanding.
See THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt for bundled font licenses.
